cleanStart.note: Fresh disposable PostgreSQL database using installed locked dependencies and compiled API. Docker and fresh dependency download are separate checks.

protections: Only the current teacher identity with question.manage and course.read can access owned drafts; generation and commit also require course.manage, active teaching assignment and a non-archived course.
Paper drafts additionally require assessment.manage; owner, organization, course and chapter are checked, and revoked drafts are filtered before pagination.
Session and permission checks run again after model calls and at commit. Row locks and a single transaction protect atomic question and paper creation; repeated saves return existing saved IDs.

Generated content is rejected for invalid answers, question counts/types, duplicate stems, HTML/control characters, missing explanations and unsupported fields. Scoring/difficulty come from the teacher blueprint.
All new questions are private and practice-disabled. The model cannot choose ownership, course, creator or release state.
Teacher materials remain user JSON data. Requests omit internal course/chapter IDs and identity fields; generation supplies no browsing tools.
Teacher generation shares the Beijing-time per-user attempt quota and single pending operation with student AI operations; failures count and deleting a draft does not reset quota.
Secrets are omitted from public configuration responses, error text, logs and screenshots.

limitations: Exactly one real DeepSeek request generated one arithmetic question and a private paper in the isolated review database. This targeted success does not establish broad subject-matter quality.
Question validation enforces structure and storage rules, not subject-matter correctness; teachers must review before publishing.
TAP HTTP totals include parent tests. The one-test responsive follow-up overlaps the 21-case browser regression.
The demo smoke is read-only and did not call a real model. Its analysisConfigured=true reflects configured capability, not an empty-key state.
Docker, fresh dependency download and remote CI were not executed as part of this verification.
